why_this_exists: orion.programme.panel_resolution's three registries name seven artifacts between them. Discovering decided panels mechanically finds five across the papers; this one is not in any registry and had never been read. The omission was invisible because a registry lists what it covers and implies nothing about what it does not.

clean_promotion_coverage.detail: the panel splits between the metric's floor and its ceiling with nothing in between; the separation is real and maximal, but a paired interval over it is zero-width because the difference is constant, so its width is not a measure of precision and must not be read beside an interval earned from variation

false_promotion_rate.detail: the panel splits between the metric's floor and its ceiling with nothing in between; the separation is real and maximal, but a paired interval over it is zero-width because the difference is constant, so its width is not a measure of precision and must not be read beside an interval earned from variation

reading: Both reported metrics come back SEPARATED_WITHOUT_VARIATION: two distinct values each, and both of those the metric's extremes. provenance_only_policy and visible_success_policy are identical on every metric the artifact reports, so a panel of four decides over three. Ten cases, every rate 0.0 or 1.0: the panel has no graded behaviour to read a margin off.
what_this_does_not_establish: that P4_METHOD_AUTHORITY_SUPPORTED is wrong. The coordinate product is the only arm scoring both 0.0 false promotion and 1.0 clean coverage; the three baselines each fail one axis. That is a real separation on this benchmark.

that a two-valued metric is the wrong metric. A closed synthetic world where the right answer is reachable and the baselines fail is informative; settling whether it is easy needs an arm that is neither perfect nor absent, which this panel does not contain.
anything about the artifact's own claim ceiling, which already states that the benchmark supports coordinate-separation and anti-laundering semantics only.
what_it_does_establish: The claim rests on a panel with two indistinguishable arms and no metric that varies by more than its endpoints, and until now no instrument had said so. That is a bound on the panel's resolving power, recorded rather than left to be read into the terminal.
edits: none. The summary artifact, its terminal and its claim ceiling are untouched.
